findings.title: no G-TVOI/MI/probe selector in deploy path
findings.evidence: deploy/select/train path free of selector symbols (Δ_info/MI stay post-hoc in diagnostics.py)

findings.title: single TD loss, no auxiliary losses
findings.evidence: src/aris_bellman/td.py returns one F.mse_loss; experiments/overcooked_v2/train_aris.py backprops aris_td_loss with no aux terms

findings.title: action selection is pure Bellman argmax
findings.evidence: experiments/overcooked_v2/train_aris.py:_select_option selects via argmax with no info-gain/selector branch

findings.title: CE is preprocessing, not in training loop
findings.evidence: experiments/overcooked_v2/train_aris.py does not call CE estimation; CE lives in ce_sampler.py (preprocessing)

findings.title: reward-scale single-source (structural)
findings.evidence: cost/shaped coefs flow from training.* into CE, preflight, eval, and td target (numeric equivalence is semantic → out of scope, jury/human)

findings.title: articulation-point bottlenecks, not degree<=2
findings.evidence: experiments/overcooked_v2/layout_parser.py uses Tarjan articulation points + region-size filter; no degree<=2 heuristic

findings.title: preflight hard gate + acceptance, no smoke bypass
findings.evidence: experiments/overcooked_v2/train_aris.py:_enforce_preflight_gate requires an accepted report; no smoke bypass

findings.title: no factor-accuracy as a primary metric
findings.evidence: evaluation is return / reference-gap grounded; no factor-label-accuracy metric

findings.title: factor deletion removes latent+route+relevance
findings.evidence: experiments/overcooked_v2/graph_builder.py:make_graph_spec derives relevance+route_map+mode_mask from `factors`; deleting a factor structurally removes all three

findings.title: P1: main evidence path oracle-free (behavior-inferred partner option)
findings.evidence: partner act() emits no true option label; executor strips the raw partner action before extract_event and re-annotates from the behavior inferencer

findings.title: P4: belief hidden state persists across option decisions
findings.evidence: EvidenceBuffer carries a persistent hidden; transitions store window-base hidden snapshots; belief decodes from hidden (episode-scoped memory)

findings.title: P3: CE artifacts expose per-pair support (skipped != measured zero)
findings.evidence: estimator emits weight_sum + estimable/skipped/measured-zero masks; pipeline reads graph.ce_min_weight from config

findings.title: P5: no true terminal-policy conditioning in the main method path
findings.evidence: role-conditioned reward/exploration/replay raise without the explicit ablation flag; option selection carries no terminal-policy argument

findings.title: S17: allow_diag_skip cannot bypass hard eval integrity checks
findings.evidence: forced-noop / evidence-policy / observed-dist / missing-evidence / oracle-source checks run regardless of --allow_diag_skip (flag scopes diagnostics only)

findings.title: S20: headline completion is ego-owned, actor-split metrics recorded
findings.evidence: eval headline = ego_correct_completion_rate keyed on ego-sole deliveries; greedy validation reports team vs ego-sole rates under distinct names

findings.title: NEW-2: checkpoint eligibility gates before publication
findings.evidence: deploy eligibility is checked before best-selection/save; stale deployable checkpoints are unlinked when no eligible checkpoint is selected

findings.title: S23: explicit train-partner split required for split claims
findings.evidence: unset train_partners hard-errors when a held-out split is declared; CE pipeline filters to train partners; all-partner runs require the explicit no-split flag
